prompt: Redesign error types for deployr CLI: structured variants with context, hint function, JSON error mode, proper exit codes.

assertions.text: Error variants carry context fields (path, operation, URL) not just inner errors
Has an error_hint function mapping error types to actionable command suggestions
Errors output as structured JSON to stderr when --json is set
Documents exit codes with at least 4 distinct values (0=success, 2=usage, 3=auth, 4=api)
Human error display shows 'error:' prefix and a separate 'hint:' line
No raw Debug formatting or library error internals shown to users
